notes.content:
🔧 Roadmap Update – Optimization, Loadout, Zombie & More
Hi everyone,

We’re kicking off a new format here on Steam: regular updates on our roadmap progress.
We usually post dev leaks (images, info, early previews) on our official Discord, but since not everyone is there, we’ll now keep you updated here as well.

👉 Click here to view the full roadmap


✅ Optimization & Game Polish Part III
This part is being handled by a specialized team, and they’ve already delivered key updates:
  DLSS integration  Performance and stability improvements  Polish passes across various systems
However, this section is still ongoing.
Part III : A major VRAM optimization update is coming soon — it should significantly improve performance across most setups.

🔧 Loadout & Weapon System – Our Current Focus
This is what our main team is working on right now.
We’re building a completely new loadout system, featuring:
  Fully reworked weapon animations  New weapons  Thousands of attachments  Variants & skins  Real gameplay effects per item (not just visual)
Every weapon in Bodycam will now be fully customizable — with thousands of unique combinations.
Here are just a few examples of what you’ll be able to create using the new system — every weapon in the game will be modifiable to this level of detail.
First look at the Raider X, one of the many new weapons in development!

notes.title: Optimization Part II
notes.content:
Bodycam Update V0.1.4.1 – Optimization Part II & Gameplay Changes

⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTICE

 This is Part II of our optimisation updates!


GENERAL OPTIMIZATION

 VRAM optimization (Part 1)
 Several memory leaks have been fixed
 Improved overall FPS and game stability
 Fixed a critical issue where bots caused lag when running
 Addressed performance drops in specific gameplay scenarios
 New engine-level tweaks added – let us know if you notice performance changes!


BODYBOMB REWORK

 2 minutes to plant the bomb
 10 seconds to plant (only within a valid bomb site)
 60 seconds until explosion
 10 seconds to defuse
 Bomb can no longer be planted outside bomb sites


OTHER CHANGES & FIXES

 Team Deathmatch restart bug has been fixed
 Versus win condition increased to 10 points
 When playing with friends, you're now more likely to be on the same team
 Zombie mode spawn system improved
 Minor bug fixes and polish applied across the game


WHAT’S NEXT?

 A new Zombie map with a fresh gameplay experience
 The upcoming Loadout system with full weapon & attachment customization
 New gameplay features related to loadouts and animations
 A brand-new multiplayer map has just been completed and is entering testing


More content is coming in the next few weeks.
In the meantime, check out the #devleak channel on our Discord to get early sneak peeks!

The Reissad Team

notes.title: DLSS Returns & Performance Optimizations Part I
notes.content:
Bodycam Update V0.1.4.0

⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTICE

 Note: This is Part I of our optimisation updates!


DLSS IS BACK!

 After encountering unforeseen compatibility issues the first time, DLSS has finally returned for good!
 A new DLSS option has been added in the graphical settings, right below the “FSR” setting.
 FrameGen is yet to be added, but it will come soon!

Let us know your experience with the current implementation and if it needs improvement!  
The last thing in the 2024 roadmap is done! (lol)

OTHER CHANGES & FIXES

 The game has been optimized further, but we’re still ironing out the issues introduced in 1.3.4.
 Upscale Quality, Anti‐Aliasing and TAA Upsampling settings work again!
 The Weapons Locker has received some new icons.
 Oil Rig shouldn’t use so much CPU anymore.
 A bunch of new skin variations have been added to most guns.
 A handful of new Operator Skins have been added!
 An R-Point softcap has been introduced! This is very experimental and will be tweaked over time (current cap: 10,000 points; above this threshold, point gains will diminish).


Don’t forget to leave a review on Steam! Your feedback is always welcome.

The Reissad Team

notes.title: Bodycam Hotfix V0.1.3.5 - Performance & Gameplay Fixes
notes.content:
Bodycam Update – Hotfix V0.1.3.5 

Hey everyone

We've just released last day, our biggest update yet, and now here's Hotfix V0.1.3.5, fixing several issues and improving overall gameplay.  

Here’s what’s new:


Performance fixes on Russian Building, Worn House, Hospital, and other maps.(We've made some improvements, but keep in mind that the big performance update is coming in the next update!)
Death tracking fixed - Death no longer counts as two deaths.
Audio improvements - Overall sound volume levels adjusted, footsteps volume balanced, correct dirt sounds now play, and outdoor ambience works properly.
Private match rewards - Playing in private matches no longer gives you any kind of rewards.
Joining late - Joining a minute before the match ends now gives you no rewards.
Note: No reward screen will play after the scoreboard while the match is ending.
Rank rewards adjustments - No rank rewards when playing with bots and fewer than 3 real players.
Hardpoint mode now ends at 200 points - Let us know if this feels too short!
Bots now stay in matches - As asked, bots will now stay in matches until the lobby starts filling up with real players.
Bot fixes - Bots now shoot properly, and their accuracy against other bots has been improved.
Zombie skins fixed - They now appear correctly instead of using test assets.
Improved match stability - Reduced chances of matches stopping abruptly.


[center]As always, let us know your feedback - Thanks for your support![/center]

notes.title: Bodycam Update V0.1.3.4 - Season 2, Bots, and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Bodycam Update V0.1.3.4 - [14/3/2025]  

⚠️ NOTE: 
This update focuses on new content, and semi-major bug fixes, while the optimizations are being handled by a specialized team and will roll out progressively. 
We would also like to mention that because of so many additions introduced in this update, there could be many bugs that we missed during bug testing stages. If you find any, please report them on our discord! 
Thank you for your patience and support while we continue improving Bodycam!

---  

NEW CONTENT  

🏆 SEASON 2 BEGINS!  
  
 Ranks have been reset!: Players now have 60 days to climb the leaderboard before the season ends, and earn exclusive rewards! 
 Season Rewards: You are now able to claim exclusive badges as rewards for your rank position in the previous season, and new operator skins for season 2!
 View Past Rankings: You can now check your rank history by visiting the Leaderboard section and selecting previous seasons.!
 Season Duration: This season will run for two months, but we may adjust future seasons based on your feedback. Let us know if you prefer shorter or longer seasons!  
 Rank Placement Change: The amount of points needed to rank up has been increased exponentially, making the grind harder and more pleasing! This change is not final though, we appreciate any feedback!
  

🔥 STREAK SYSTEM - DAILY FREE SKINS!  
  
 Daily Win Rewards: Win one match per day to earn a free skin.  
 No Duplicate Skins: Skins are chosen from those you do not own yet.  
 Consistency Matters: If you miss a day, your streak resets! Stay consistent to maximize your rewards.  
 Future Updates: More streak-based rewards will be added in future updates!  
  

🎯 NEW GAME MODE - HARDPOINT  
  
 Objective-Based Gameplay: Hardpoint is a fast-paced mode where teams must capture and hold a rotating zone to earn points.  
 Winning Conditions: The team that reaches 200 points first, or has the most points by the end of the timer wins!
 Rotating Capture Points: The zone moves periodically, forcing players to anticipate rotations and reposition before the enemy does.  
 The More The Better: The more teammates you have on the hardpoint, the more points your team receives!
 Best for Tactical Players: Hardpoint is perfect for those who enjoy a mix of team strategy and aggressive play-styles. Try it out, and let us know your feedback!  
  

🗺️ NEW MAP - PAINTBALL ARENA  
  
 Designed for Competitive Modes: A paintball-inspired map tailored for Versus, Body Bomb, and Hardpoint game modes.  
 Ground-Level Combat: Unlike Airsoft, Bomb House, or Russian Building, this map has no elevated areas, ensuring a level playing field.  
 Cover-Based Movement: Small, scattered covers force players to stay mobile and react quickly to enemy movement.  
 Symmetrical Layout: The map is evenly designed, providing a balanced and fair competitive experience.  
  

---  

🤖 BOTS - DYNAMIC MATCHMAKING AI  
NOTE: The bots are not perfect just yet, and will be improved over time!
  
 Dynamic Matchmaking Support: Bots automatically fill empty slots and leave as real players join. They are designed to maintain the game’s pacing and balance.  
 Filling Lobbies & Expanding Player Base: Bots have been added to ensure that matches feel full and competitive, particularly in regions where the player base is still growing. This helps Bodycam expand globally and improves matchmaking speeds.  
 Adaptive AI Difficulty: Bots start at an easier level but dynamically adjust their difficulty based on player performance. If you're dominating, they will get smarter and more challenging for you.  
 Realistic Player Behavior: Bots analyze the battlefield, take alternative routes, use flanking tactics, and engage dynamically in fights.  
 Objective-Focused AI: Bots interact with objectives just like real players; They plant and defuse bombs, capture Hardpoints, and support their team in tactical engagements.  
 Option to disable bots: If you're hosting a match, you can disable bots in the settings before starting a match!  
 Bot Kill Point Rewards: Killing a bot grants ¼ of a player kill's value. For example, if a player kill grants 40 RPoints, a bot kill will grant 10 RPoints.
 Temporary bot limit: For testing, bots will fill lobbies up to 4 players for the time being!  

---  

🌍 MAP REWORKS & FIXES  
We have started reworking several maps to improve visual quality, level design, and balance. However, this is just the beginning! These improvements are not final. This is a first step to better organization and testing community feedback before the full map overhauls planned in the 2025 roadmap.

  
 Worn House Revamped: Improved textures, lighting, and overall level design for better balance and visuals.  
 Russian Building Now Features a Redesigned Outside Area: Expanded for more strategic opportunities and improved navigation.  
 A New Staircase Has Been Added To Russian Building: Changing the way players navigate and making gameplay more dynamic.
 Airsoft House Optimizations: The map has seen a considerable amount of changes and optimizations, removing annoying spots and more, making gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.
 Training Range Now Has New Guns: FOSTECH shotgun and Revolver have been added to training range for everyone to test them out!  
 Countless hitboxes fixed across all the maps: Including Russian Building trees, Rome's bushes, and more!
 "Logistics" Was temporarily disabled for a small rework  
  

---  

🎨 SKINS & CUSTOMIZATION UPDATES  
  
 37+7 New Operator Skins Added! There's 37 new skins you can buy in the shop, and 7 more you can get from season rewards!
 A handful of new weapons skins! A couple more weapon skins were added this update for some guns!
 New National Flag Badges Added: Represent your country with pride! All nations now have unique flag badges.  
 More Badges Coming Soon: Future updates will introduce new badges with different meanings and significance.  
 Profile Picture Now Reflects Your Operator Skin: Your in-game avatar is now represented by your chosen operator skin, adding more immersion and natural team identification. We would like your feedback regarding this change, let us know if you like it or not!
  

---  

OTHER ADDITIONS, CHANGES, FIXES & POLISH  
  
 Added voice lines that play at start of rounds and other situations  
 Added [RADIO] audio setting, that controls the previously mentioned voice lines  
 Added Take/Interact key bind option (Default: E)  
 Added a new scope  
 Added new walking sounds  
 Reworked Main Menu UI completely  
Note: UI Bugs are still present, this is just the first part of the UI rework!
 Nerfed and Buffed rank point rewards for certain gamemodes  
 Improved and adjusted the friendly name UI 
 Team killers are now automatically kicked after 3 TKs, regardless of their performance in the match 
 Friendly "Green Box" no longer disappears when too close, minimizing confusion and accidental team kills 
 Joining a match too late will no longer grant you any rewards, preventing players from abusing the system by joining late and getting free rewards. 
 Players will no longer earn any points in private matches. These games will be purely for practice. 
 RTSS (Riva Tuner Statistics Server) works again  
 Improved the player hit registration  
 Improved issues with body bomb rounds not ending properly  
 Improved issue where lasers unintentionally lit up entire rooms  
 Improved issues with private lobbies not working  
 Resolved issues with pump shotgun and revolver getting stuck  
 Fixed issue with weapon skins not saving if you don't have an operator skin equipped  
 Fixed issues with the resolution not being saved  
 Fixed issues with the shop being empty  
 Fixed issues with the bomb not dropping from dead players  
 Fixed issue where lasers caused a large red flash when turned on  
 Fixed bug that disabled the green box and names of friendlies at the start of a match  
 Players can no longer steal the bomb from a teammate  
 Ranks are now spelled correctly  
 Voice chat volume is no longer affected by the "Master Volume" setting  

+ COUNTLESS other smaller bug fixes and changes!

notes.title: Bodycam 2025 - Q&A 2025 Answered
notes.content:
❓ Bodycam 2025 - Q&A ❓

Hey everyone!  

We know that after our recent announcements, many of you have questions about what’s coming next. We took the time to anticipate the most common ones and decided to put together this Q&A to provide clear answers on all key topics!  

Of course, if you still have more questions or want to stay up to date with everything happening around Bodycam, join us on Discord!  

Thank you all for your continued support. We hope these answers help you get a better understanding of what’s ahead, show our commitment to transparency, and most importantly, get you excited for the future! 🚀🔥  


❓ How did we start in the game industry?  

We started developing games over ten years ago, beginning with small projects that allowed us to grow and refine our skills. Over the years, we explored Unreal Engine, mastered its tools, and improved our creations.

When Unreal Engine 5 was released, it marked a turning point in the industry with its groundbreaking realism. During a school study project at the launch of UE5, we discovered photorealism. The goal of this project was to explore the engine’s limits, and as we progressed, we realized that our PC was capable of running an ultra-realistic scene.

Initially, our idea was to create an ultra-realistic shooter on UE5. But during our prototypes, we discovered that the only way to push realism from “realistic” to “photorealistic” was by degrading the image using lens effects that mimic action cameras.

You’ve probably noticed that all recent ultra-realistic games adopt camera effects degradations. It’s the same principle used in cinema: in action scenes, everything moves, everything is blurry, making it harder to distinguish details and, ultimately, making the scene feel more believable.

Of course, we agreed that this degradation would feel odd if it came directly from the player’s eyes. So, we justified this effect by incorporating bodycams equipped by soldiers this became the name of our game.


⚙️ Game Optimisation & Technical Improvements   

  
What are your plans for game optimisation?  
➡️ Optimisation is a major focus, and our specialised team is working on improving performance with every update. We’re even planning a dedicated optimisation update in the future.  

Why was DLSS removed, and will it return?  
➡️ DLSS interfered with FSR, causing major lag issues. A team is investigating, and DLSS will return once the issue is fixed.  

Will there be host migration & dedicated servers?  
➡️ A specialised team is working on host migration to improve online play. Dedicated servers were not recommended for our current game modes, but with host migration, things will get much better!  

Will an anti-cheat system be implemented?  
➡️ Yes! A robust anti-cheat solution is in development to ensure fair play.  
  


🔫 Gameplay & Content Additions 

  
Will night vision be added?  
➡️ Yes! Night Vision Goggles (NVG) will be available in special rounds, where unique gameplay modifiers like suppressed weapons will also be introduced.  

Are bots planned?  
➡️ Yes! Bots will arrive in update 1.3.4, with difficulty that adapts to player skill levels.  

Will there be snipers & sniper-focused maps?  
➡️ Snipers are coming after the animation overhaul.  

Will weapon customisation be added?  
➡️ Yes! Attachments and sights will be introduced alongside loadouts, which will be available in non-competitive game modes like Deathmatch.  

Will there be more zombie maps?  
➡️ Definitely! New zombie maps are coming, but they take a lot of development time.  

Will there be a campaign mode?  
➡️ Not initially planned, but we’ll run a community poll

Will hostage rescue be a game mode?  
➡️ Same Not initially planned, but we’ll run a community poll to see if players want it!  

Will more lens effects be added?  
➡️ Yes! Snow, blood, and more immersive effects are in the works.  

Is a gore system planned?  
➡️ Yes! A fully custom gore system is in development, and we’ve already shown some WIP footage on Discord.  

Will more weapons be added?  
➡️ Yes! Can’t reveal which ones yet, but stay tuned!  

Will kill cams be added?  
➡️ No plans for now—it’s a complex feature to implement properly.  
  


🎮 Customisation & Quality of Life Improvements 

  
Why were player cosmetics changed? Will the old system return?  
➡️ The old system caused performance and engine issues, so we had to replace it. We’ll announce any future changes if we find a workaround!  

Will the friend system be improved?  
➡️ Yes! The party system is getting major improvements in update 1.3.4.  

Will Proximity Chat & VOIP be fixed?  
➡️ Yes! Fixes are in development to make it work properly.  

Will daily & weekly challenges be added?  
➡️ Yes, they are planned for a future update!  

Will there be tactical emotes or hand signs?  
➡️ No “Fortnite-style” emotes, but custom animations for match intros/outros are coming!  

Will HDR support return?  
➡️ HDR was temporarily disabled for rework, but it will return in an improved form.  
  


🛠️ Other Features & Future Plans   

  
Will there be mod support?  
➡️ Not planned for now, but we may explore it in the far future.  

Will there be a drone racing mode?  
➡️ Maybe 😉  

How did the studio start in the gaming industry?  
➡️ We started six years ago with small projects, building our skills over time. Once Unreal Engine 5 launched, we started working on Worst World, which evolved into BODYCAM!  

What’s the current state of Reissad Studio?  
➡️ We’re growing fast! More details coming in an upcoming announcement.  

What happened to the map "Tumblewood"?  
➡️ It had major performance & graphical issues, so we had to temporarily disable it. We’ll bring it back once it’s fixed!  

Will animations be improved?  
➡️ An animation overhaul is already in progress!  

Will left-handed POV be added?  
➡️ Not likely—it would require a completely new set of animations for every gun.  

Playstation & Xbox versions?  
➡️ CLASSIFIED.
  


📢 Stay Updated! 

We hope this Q&A answers most of your questions! If you have more, join us on Discord to ask directly!  

🔥 The future of Bodycam is bigger than ever, and we’re excited to share this journey with you all! 🚀

notes.title: Quick Update On The Progress
notes.content:
This announcement was posted on 23/01/2025 in our Discord!

Hello everyone! 

We wanted to take a moment to update you on things. We know you’ve been waiting and like to hear from us, so here’s where we’re at right now:

We’re working on a big update that’s coming soon. It will include things like bots, the start of a new season, many bug fixes, and several new functionalities! It’s a very ambitious update that has taken a lot of time already, especially after the holiday season.

Meanwhile, we’ve been doing more than just working on the game. Over the past seven months, we have been navigating the world of game development, attending events and meeting amazing people, and even recruiting talent to help us lay a strong foundation for the future of BODYCAM and Reissad Studio!

Last month, many opportunities and collaborations have materialized, and we’re excited to share that we’re now working with people that have incredible talent, including professionals who’ve worked on major games!
With these collaborations, we will be able to push our capabilities even further with improving BODYCAM, delivering quality content, and polishing the game to the point of the full release out of early access!


We have three major announcements coming :
(Not in order)

 A message about the evolution of Reissad Studio: who we’ve recruited, who we’re collaborating with, and most importantly, how these partnerships will benefit both Bodycam and the studio itself!
We cannot wait to share this information with you, We’re confident this will be super exciting, and you’ll be hyped about the game’s future!

 The 2025 roadmap!
Yes, we’re taking our time... but only to make sure it’s well thought out and achievable!
We will present all the amazing features that it will include, share our vision, and even explain how we plan to bring them to life!
This will also be a great opportunity for you to share your own suggestions about what you’d like to be prioritized and what is important to you.

 And last, we will announce the major 1.3.4 update, detailing all the new features and changes!


Thank you so much for your patience, and thank you again for your support, we couldn’t have pushed this project to such lengths without you!

See you soon for these exciting announcements!

Reissad Studio

Bodycam Update V0.1.3.3 - November 11, 2024

⚠️ NOTE: This update focuses on new content, while bug fixes are being handled by a specialized team and will roll out progressively. We appreciate your patience and support as we continue improving Bodycam.

NEW CONTENT  
  
 Rome (New Map): A large, intricately designed map featuring a mix of open spaces and tight corridors. Optimized for Bomb Mode, it introduces multiple strategic planting zones to intensify tactical gameplay.  
 Logistics (New Map): One of the smallest maps in Bodycam, tailored for Versus Mode and 1v1 Duel Mode. Designed for close-quarters combat, it ensures action-packed matches as opposing teams face off head-to-head.  
 Oil Rig Returns: Back by popular demand, this map has been reintroduced with some incomplete features (e.g., missing floors). Improvements will continue based on community feedback.  
 Tumblewood Temporarily Disabled: This map is currently under rework. Stay tuned for updates!  
  

CHANGES  
  
 Bomb Mode Zones: Added strategic A, B, and C planting zones. Planting here cuts detonation time in half, offering more tactical depth. Default planting rules remain for strategic flexibility.  
 Versus Rounds Adjustments: Reduced the number of rounds to win from seven to five. Sides now switch after two or three rounds, depending on progress, for faster, more dynamic matches.  
 Lighting and Shadow Fixes: Shadows are now enforced for all players, preventing unfair advantages from file manipulation while maintaining immersion.  
 Bad Host Punishment: Hosts that leave before the match ends will now be penalized.  
 General Map Updates: Minor tweaks and adjustments have been made to improve gameplay flow and visuals across all maps.  
  

FIXES  
  
 Lighting Exploits: Fixed bugs allowing players to disable shadows unfairly.  
 Generator Timing in Zombie Mode: Resolved issues where generators activated at incorrect intervals.  
 Collision in Pit Mode: Improved collision mechanics for smoother gameplay.  
 Bomb Mode Timers: Adjusted planting and detonation mechanics for better balance.  
  

OTHER CHANGES  
  
 8 new skins added.  
 R point rewards and shop prices adjusted.  
 Vaulting mechanics limited for realism and to prevent accessing unreachable spots.  
 Teams with friends now auto-balance better.  
 Knife knockback adjusted.  
 Grenade kills now count properly.  
 Fixed collision and stuck spots across all maps.  
 "The Pit" mode renamed to "Duel."  
 Kicking disabled in GunGame and Deathmatch modes due to abuse.  
 Scoreboard and lobby settings improvements.  
 Fixed labels in settings for better clarity.  
  

RANK RESET & SEASONS (COMMUNITY SUGGESTION)  
We are exploring the idea of a rank reset paired with a seasonal structure to enhance the competitive experience:  
  
 Season Duration: Each season will last 1-2 months, with ranks resetting at the end.  
 Seasonal Rewards: Earn exclusive skins based on your rank at the season's end.  
 Rank History: Track your performance and ranks across previous seasons in a dedicated section.  
  

💬 Community Question: Should we start the next season immediately (with rewards distributed later) or wait until the reward system is fully implemented? Share your thoughts in the ⁠Suggestions channel!  

Thank you for your continued support, and see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Bodycam Update V0.1.2.8: New Maps, Modes, and Key Improvements
notes.content:
Bodycam update V0.1.2.8

SUMMARY  
Bodycam update V0.1.2.8 introduces two new maps, "Public Pool" and "The Pit," along with new game modes: a 1v1 duel and Team Death Match. The update also features reworks of existing maps, including balancing adjustments and improved gameplay elements, alongside enhanced UI and various fixes for a smoother experience.


ADDED  
  
 NEW MAP : Public Pool  
Fight through a derelict public pool complex, offering close quarters combat and open areas for intense gunfights.  
 NEW MAP : The Pit  
An arena-style map designed for intense 1v1 duels, with randomized layouts for each match. *(ONLY AVAILABLE IN THE NEW "THE PIT" MODE)*  
 NEW GAMEMODE : The Pit  
1V1 duel with the map changing each round. Perfect game mode to face your friends and find out who is the strongest.  
 NEW GAMEMODE : Team Death Match  
(2 teams with respawn enabled, first team to reach 100 kills wins).  


INFORMATIONS  
  
 Gamemode Name Switch :  
The previous "Team Deathmatch" is now called Versus, to make room for the new traditional Team Death Match mode.  
 Team Selection System Improved :  
Team selection now takes place at the start of the game and cannot be changed in-game for better balancing.  
 Contributors Graffiti Added :  
All the contributors' graffiti have been added to the training map and some will appear in future maps or in reworks of old maps!  


CHANGES  
  
 Russian Building Modified and Improved :  
Added new paths and made balancing adjustments.  
 Abandoned Hospital Modified and Improved :  
Various collision fixes for smoother gameplay.  
 Worn House Modified and Improved :  
Added new paths, new visuals, and made balancing adjustments.  
 Player Spawn System :  
We improved the spawn system by making it more intelligent and flexible for all game modes, like spawning automatically next to your allies in modes that allow it.  


UI  
  
 Scoreboard Improved :  
Enhanced visuals and added player ranks next to their names.  
 Settings Improved :  
Visuals improved and you can now change your lobby settings in the settings menu.  
 UI : Map & Gamemode Selection :  
You now select the mode first, then the maps available for that mode. Unique and mode-specific maps are labeled accordingly. We've also added labels like "new," "updated," "patch," and more to keep you informed on each mode and map's status.  


PLAYER  
  
 Player Skin reacts to the Dynamic Weather :  
Depending on the weather, your clothing accessories will now react to it, making characters even more realistic.  
 Player reacts to Flashbang and Scream :  
Now you can tell if your enemies are under the effect of your flashbang by hearing them scream. Be careful, as the effect may vary depending on how the enemy received the flash.  
 Aiming Sensitivity and Balancing :  
FPS-dependent adjustment of aiming sensitivity and motion balancing. For players with high or low FPS, camera movements will now remain consistent.  
 Camera :  
Improved camera movement and effects, including reworked leaning mechanics.  
 Right/Left Sprinting :  
Added right and left sprinting options for enhanced mobility.  


FIXES  
  
 Dead Body Performance Optimization :  
Reduced performance impact caused by dead bodies.  
 Gun Game Weapon Swap Fix :  
Addressed weapon swap issues in Gun Game mode.  
 Bunny Hop Fix :  
Fixed issues with bunny hopping.  
 Mantle Animation Fix :  
Resolved animation issues when mantling.  
 Inventory Drop Fix :  
Fixed problems with dropping items from the inventory.  
 R-Points/Rank Points System Reworked :  
Improved rank points attribution for better progression tracking.  


BETA  
  
 Localization and Translation (All text not yet translated and will default to English) :  
Added support for the following languages: French, Chinese, Russian, Dutch.  


Have a great weekend!

notes.title: BODYCAM HELP - ACCESSIBILITY AND PERFORMANCE TIPS !
notes.content:
IN-GAME ASSISTANCE AND PERFORMANCE TIPS

Hello Bodycam Community!

We hope you are all excited for the game release on June 7, 2024! We wanted to take a moment to provide tips on how to optimize your gameplay experience.
Our goal is to highlight all the new questions that bodycam brings and to provide you with our answers!

PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION

The game performs better than you might expect. If you have any doubts, please check the minimum requirements on Steam or simply ask our community on Discord, who can give you an approximate idea of the FPS you can expect!

For the best gaming experience, you might need to adjust some settings, especially if you encounter FPS drops or motion sickness. Here are some tips:

➡️ FPS Issues and FSR/DLSS Settings:
To improve your frame rate, consider enabling FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR). This feature can significantly boost your FPS without sacrificing too much visual quality. To enable FSR:
1. Go to Settings > Graphics.
2. Enable FSR and adjust the level according to your preference.

Additionally, you can enable FSR Frame Generation, which can greatly increase your FPS:
1. Go to Settings > Graphics.
2. Enable FSR Frame Generation to benefit from higher frame rates.

➡️ Lower Graphics:
1. Go to Settings > Graphics.
2. Put in HIGH (except motion blur)

DO NOT TOUCH ANY OTHER SETTINGS YOU DONT KNOW

We are also working on integrating NVIDIA DLSS, which will be available soon to further enhance your gaming performance. Keep an eye out for this update!

POTENTIAL MOTION SICKNESS

We have noticed that some players might experience motion sickness while watching videos of the game. HOWEVER, when playing, this is significantly reduced as you control your character and are actively engaged in the action. 
Therefore, very few players actually need to activate the following settings:

➡️ Camera Sensitivity: Lower the camera sensitivity to reduce rapid movements.
➡️ Camera Shake: Turn off camera shake effects in the Settings menu.
➡️ Lean Settings: Adjusting the lean settings to improve your comfort while playing: Toggle vs. Hold Lean: Choose between toggle or hold for leaning, based on your preference, in the Settings > Controls menu.

We hope these tips help enhance your gaming experience. Your comfort and enjoyment are our top priorities!

FEEDBACK AND SUPPORT

Remember, your feedback is crucial in helping us improve Bodycam. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please report them in our Discord channels:
- ⁠🔧┆bug
- ⁠🚧┆feedback

Thank you for being a part of our community and for helping us make Bodycam the best it can be. We can't wait to hear your thoughts and see you in the game!

The Reissad Studio Team

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44020457/d08ae7c96154862a95f83d016441757974e0e9a8.png

Well, well, well, it's finally time...


 The early access of Bodycam is now publicly accessible on Steam!

 Remember that our roadmap is available, so you can be aware of what's to come in the next year!

 We are also glad to announce that a new map will be added next week!

 Also, we have made a community compilation from last week-end's playtest. You can see it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OFUyIZSttJ8

 ❤️ Once again, the whole team is so appreciative of all the support we've gotten since the beginning of the project. We won't be able to thank you all enough.


ROAD MAP 2024 BRIEFING

We have some great news to share with you today! Thanks to your valuable feedback during the playtest session, most of the issues encountered by players have now been fixed.

We are excited to present our roadmap for 2024, starting with the release of Bodycam in early access.
ㅤ
Since Q2 is already well underway and ends in late June, it isn't as packed as the other periods. However, this will give you an idea of the direction we're heading and the points we're revealing today.

At the start of each quarter, we will launch community requests, allowing you to vote for the best ideas to be integrated into the game. These ideas will come from the ⁠suggestions channel (on discord) where everyone can create suggestions and vote for their favorites.

It's important to note that this roadmap is not set in stone, and we will likely add new features based on our progress. This roadmap was determined as if we continued to work as a team of two, but with ongoing recruitment, the roadmap will expand in the future!

You can soon find more detailed points on our website: reissad.com/RoadMap. We won't reveal everything, as we want to keep some surprises for you, and because in game development, it's possible to deviate a bit from the initial plan.

Thank you all, you can already start making suggestions now, and the first community request will begin in early July!

Have a great day, and see you in-game!

The Reissad Studio Team
